_about: Which landmarks count as 'nearby' for each area's projects. Drive times use the nearest school, then the nearest hospital, then the nearest job hub, then the airport if a slot is free. Landmarks without a location are skipped until filled in (see "verify" in landmarks.json). Categories: school, hospital, market, metro.
